title: spec + skills: the titleFormat describe and the objectstack-data skill still steer a composite record title into a formula field (follow-up to #25071, ruling 6308445871)
body:
Filing gate **③ a follow-up owed by landing work**, from the contract review of PR #25127 (card #25071) and its dev report. Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 3 (session `session_01D6F9axfoPzR7t8G1J7Ytzz`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is left (`origin/main` `03966ceae0`)

PR #25127 re-words the lint messages, ADR-0079 D3 and `formulas.mdx`. These copies of the old prescription ("a composite title → a `returnType: 'text'` formula designated `nameField`") sit outside that card's surface:

- **`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:2843`, the `titleFormat` describe.** Its generated copies are `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx:167`, `references/api/metadata.mdx:964` and `references/system/migration.mdx:349` and `:643`. The reconciliation note at `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts:404` quotes it.
- **`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:88` and `:90`,** the published skill AI authors read. It is a governed surface (Tier H).

## Wanted

The same reconciliation #25071 made, under ruling 6308445871 (#24981, letter A) and ADR-0079 addendum item 9:
- a composite title that import, sort or search must match is a stored computed field (a non-formula field with an `expression`, the #24619 shape);
- a text formula title stays legal for display only.

The spec half regenerates the reference pages: `@objectstack/spec` `patch`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. The skill half is its own Tier H edit.

Not in scope: the in-repo packages whose `display_title` fields are text formulas, and the HotCRM migration card the ruling already routes.

**Order:** after PR #25127.

## Dedupe

Parent: #25071. Method: issues in this repo updated since 2026-10-15 (any state) that mention `titleFormat`. Hits:
- #25071, the parent;
- #24814 (open), person-facing template slots, a different subject;
- #24665 and #24611 (closed), approval and sharing titles.

None of them re-words this describe or this skill. **New.**
